answer: Locks are logged in vertex, expire in ferrous, and quartz lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 54 aliases therefore needs 129 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1827 identities would post 2122 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
